sans.$description: The sans role. Workhorse faces for UI, body text and headings.

serif.$description: The serif role. Editorial and long-form reading faces.

display.$description: The display role. High-impact faces for headlines and heroes. Large sizes only.

mono.$description: The mono role. Fixed-width faces for code blocks, technical UI and developer docs.

handwriting.$description: The handwriting role. Accent faces for personality. Short text only, used sparingly.

slab.$description: The slab role. Sturdy faces that bridge serif and display.
